verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers multiple headless/CI-friendly automation surfaces: a full REST API for programmatic control usable with orchestrators like Airflow, a Terraform provider for config-as-code, abctl/Docker/Kubernetes deployment for headless environments, PyAirbyte for scripted/Python pipelines, and cron/schedule-based sync triggers without UI interaction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on CI-pipeline case study and confirmation of a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), which slightly limits verification depth.
